title: LADA Y vs BladeRunners, Oct 5
notes: Home game at Kirkland against BladeRunners: we wore white with blue numbers on the home bench right of center, BladeRunners red. The video is a recording of LiveBarn's player (3438x1374), scaled up to Kirkland's usual 3840x1536.

Periods from the arena scoreboard: 0:05-19:39, 21:08-39:37 and 41:07-66:51 of the video (the empty-ice proposal merged the 2nd and 3rd). The operator didn't start the clock until 0:55: the opening faceoff was at 0:05 and BladeRunners scored at 0:41 with the board still at 18:00, so the 1st runs from 0:05. The board ran a 1:00 intermission countdown after the 1st and the 2nd. The clock ran through stoppages in the 1st and 2nd except the last minute, and stopped at whistles in the 3rd; the video reaches the final horn. Hilfer #31 was in our net, the right one in the 1st and 3rd, the left in the 2nd.

Goals from SportNinja's game sheet, placed in the video by the scoreboard and checked by eye: ours at 7:05 (clock 11:48, 1st, Lisitsyn #83), 25:50 (13:19, 2nd, Lisitsyn #70), 34:01 (5:08, 2nd, Barkov #97 from Podkorytov #82 and Yafunyaev #29), 44:24 (14:44, 3rd, Barkov #97 from Mischenko #72 and Shakhov #78) and 61:53 (3:50, 3rd, Podkorytov #82 from Petrov #18); BladeRunners' at 0:41 (the sheet's 17:50, before the clock started; #85 Griffin), 4:57 (13:58, 1st, #42 Scheib), 10:33 (8:22, #42 Scheib), 18:19 (0:38, #8 Tastad), 19:12 (0:04, #8 Tastad), 28:46 (10:24, 2nd, #29 Dubeau on the power play), 36:26 (2:42, #42 Scheib), 50:05 (11:11, 3rd, #29 Dubeau) and 63:30 (2:40, #29 Dubeau). Final 5-9.
Shots on goal from the board: LADA Y 25, BladeRunners 39 (8-8, 9-14, 8-17 by period), the same as SportNinja's sheet.

Penalties, from the board's panels and the players skating into the box: Petrov #18 tripping in the 2nd (infraction at 27:04 of the video, whistle 27:08, clock about 12:04; the sheet's 11:38 is when it went on the board; the board ran 3:00 and their power-play goal at 28:46 ended it) and Lisitsyn #70 slashing in the 3rd (whistle at 58:08, clock 6:05; 2:00, killed off). The sheet calls both 2-minute minors.

Played: 12 skaters, LADA's planned lines plus Beregovoy, who wore #67 on the white jersey (154 reads of 67, one of 87; the sheet has him as #87). Didn't play: Sokolov #4, Belousenko #11, Akulov #37, Unuchek #49 and Olyanich #89; the sheet agrees. The 81 reads of "4" were all Ber #14 with the 1 cut off.

One review row was labeled by hand: R0 in the 1st (0:55-1:04), Lisitsyn #32 by his long dark pants with a grey ankle band. Three lineup stretches were checked in full frames and fixed with on/off entries: the 1st period's first minute, before the clock started (Barkov #97, Kondratenko #12, Petrov #18, Lisitsyn #70 and Lisitsyn #83 from the opening faceoff; after the first goal #18, #70 and #83 changed for Lisitsyn #32, Beregovoy #67 and Shakhov #78), the start of the 3rd, 41:07-43:04 (Lisitsyn #32 on, his number seldom facing the camera; Ber #14 on to 43:04), and Yafunyaev #29 on through Barkov's goal at 34:01, his track lost at the blue line.
